en: A sepia-toned, vintage street view labeled at the top with the words 'Trento - Corso S. Croce'. The image shows a long, straight avenue bordered by tall trees and stone posts, leading toward a cluster of buildings and a church-like structure in the distance. Snow is visible on the ground and on the mountains that rise in the background, suggesting a winter scene in an Alpine town.
